name: Boys & Girls Clubs of America
summary: The national organisation of about 1,000 local Boys & Girls Club organisations, which run nearly 5,500 after-school and summer Clubs for 1.6 million US children and teens; BGCA makes grants to Clubs and trains and supports them.

spending.source: https://www.bgca.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/BGCA-2025-Signed-Consolidated-FS-Only-5-20-26.pdf (audited consolidated statement of activities, year to 31 December 2025, p. 5: programme services $353,995 thousand = on-site assistance to member Clubs and establishment of new Clubs $178,112k + leadership training, development and support of youth programs $175,883k)

lines.label: On-site assistance to Clubs, leadership training and youth programmes (including grants to Clubs)
lines.source: https://www.bgca.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/BGCA-2025-Signed-Consolidated-FS-Only-5-20-26.pdf (statement of activities 2025, p. 5: on-site assistance $178,112 thousand, of which awards and grants $71,600k; leadership training, development and support of youth programmes $175,883 thousand, of which awards and grants $141,170k, mostly federal youth-programme money passed through to Clubs; statement of functional expenses p. 6). One model with two branches (grants to Clubs, BGCA's own services); about $3 million of advocacy across both lines is valued as a side effect in the same model.
